title: The Grateful Dead Live at Betty Nelson's Organic Raspberry Farm on 1968-09-02
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (1/2-inch 4-track reels recorded on Ampex 440) -> Dat (Tascam DA30/44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding soundboard capture of the primal 9/2/68 show – a smoking Dark Star, epic The Eleven second‑theme jam and high‑octane Caution/Feedback.
ai_review.review: This C. Miller soundboard tape delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets the band’s six‑cylinder fire shine through.  Highlights include a monster Dark Star, an extended second‑theme jam in The Eleven, and the electric surge of Caution into Feedback, all performed at peak energy.  Even though a couple of tracks are noted as out of order, the recording quality remains excellent.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high (mostly 5‑star) reviews praising both performance and audio; few minor criticisms do not detract from the overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix with outstanding clarity; reviewers repeatedly thank C. Miller for the superb audio despite occasional notes about track order.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, primal set that rolls relentlessly; the band is described as firing on all six cylinders with seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for opening the The Eleven jam with a classic lick and delivering powerful lead guitar throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for his vocal intensity and “crazy” rhythm work alongside Pigpen.
